  • Test Suite Structuring: Organize test suites using frameworks such as Jest, Pytest, or JUnit.
  • Data-Driven Testing: Parameterize tests so a single test case covers multiple input scenarios.
  • Visual Regression Testing: Apply tools such as Percy or Applitools to catch unintended visual changes in the interface.

Essential Skills

  • Academic Background: Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a degree programme in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Programming Fundamentals: Working familiarity with at least one programming language such as JavaScript, Python, or Java.

Beneficial Skills

  • React Experience: Experience building or testing React applications, including component testing with tools such as React Testing Library.
  • Full-Stack Awareness: Understanding of how frontend, backend, and database layers interact, to design more meaningful end-to-end tests.
  • Root-Cause Debugging: Able to read and debug both frontend and backend code to trace a failure to its underlying cause.

opportunities.title: Chief Architect
opportunities.description: Headquarters: Remote, United States Chief Architect Remote - US Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation. This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems. This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity. The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it. This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO. Responsibilities and Duties Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution. Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction. Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization. Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction. Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability. Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk. Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning. Platform Architecture and Technical Vision Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations. Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability. Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences. Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities. Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues. Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed. Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation. AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases. Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement. Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms. Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems. Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability. Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features. Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations. Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics. Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence. Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement. Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage. Product, Business, and Customer Impact Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage. Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps. Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt. Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required. Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions. Engineering Culture and Technical Talent Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization. Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship. Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers. Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution. Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans. Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience. Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers. Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls. Travel Requirements Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings. Required Skills and Qualifications Experience Level 15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems. Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role. Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers. Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments. Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers. Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles. Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity. Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production. Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners. Technical Depth Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing. Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations. Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages. Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability. Leadership and Judgment Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset. Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders. Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient. Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy. Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities. Preferred Qualifications and Attributes Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations. Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains. Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems. Experience architecting AI-native product capabilities, including LLM-enabled workflows, AI agents or copilots, model evaluation, retrieval systems, feedback loops, and production monitoring. Experience building internal developer platforms, platform infrastructure, data platforms, ML pipelines, or large-scale analytics systems. Experience designing highly configurable enterprise platforms without creating unbounded customization or implementation complexity. Experience participating in strategic customer architecture reviews or technical due diligence with large enterprise customers. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; PhD a plus but not required. Candidate Profile The strongest candidate will be a deeply technical, hands-on architect who still has the range to shape company-level technical direction. They are not a generic enterprise architect, process owner, or strategy-only leader. They are a builder and technical decision-maker who can personally engage with Legion’s hardest problems and earn the respect of the strongest engineers in the company. They should be comfortable moving between: Code and architecture. Product ambition and technical feasibility. AI innovation and production reliability. Startup speed and enterprise-grade rigor. Long-term platform strategy and immediate technical execution. They should be opinionated but not dogmatic, decisive but not reckless, and pragmatic without accepting mediocrity. They should be able to simplify complex systems, identify the real technical risks, and force clarity where teams are stuck in ambiguity. Compensation and Benefits Salary Range: Base Salary Range $300,000- $385,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity. At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. Our posted salary range is done in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region, town, or cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount budgeted internally, and internal equity for the same position within the company. Benefits include, but are not limited to: $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment. 401k plan. Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays. Parental Leave. Equity. Monthly Wellness Reimbursement. Monthly Lunch on Legion. ABOUT LEGION Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. For more information, visit https://legion.co EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our team of fun, welcoming, values-driven and collaborative problem solvers has one focus at the heart of everything we do: human experience. And we transform businesses by creating engaging, inspiring moments using strategy, creativity, data and technology—all backed by the global technological power of Infosys.

Experience & Tech

We are a cross-unit and cross-location tech and experience team. As part of Infosys, we belong to a leading global technology company with access to solutions and extensive know-how in the fields of commerce, marketing automation and AI, among others. 

Our local benefits

You will be responsible for planning and managing the Technical Project Management Team (approx. 5–10 people) and its activities, as well as for the professional and personal development of team members.

opportunities.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend) - Global Marts
opportunities.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Who We Are

Global Marts builds the technology behind DoorDash's own grocery and retail operations across DashMart, Wolt Market, and Deliveroo Hop.

Our systems decide what products our stores stock, how much inventory to purchase, which vendors to source from, how warehouses execute orders, and what prices customers see.

We build everything from forecasting and replenishment systems to vendor management, warehouse execution, labor scheduling, space optimization, and pricing. Our in-house forecasting platform has replaced third-party solutions and now powers production globally.

This isn't a traditional CRUD backend environment. Much of our work involves designing new systems that solve complex operational problems at global scale.

 

What You'll Do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll work primarily with Go or Kotlin and take end-to-end ownership of production systems and complex technical initiatives.

You'll:

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems that support inventory, purchasing, warehouse operations, pricing, and fulfillment.
  • Own technical solutions from problem definition and design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation.
  • Work on data-heavy systems where software engineering meets forecasting, optimization, and operational decision-making.
  • Turn complex and sometimes ambiguous business problems into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions.
  • Make and influence architectural decisions, balancing scalability, reliability, development speed, and long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams to shape solutions and technical direction.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and operational excellence of the systems you own.
  • Support and raise the engineering standards of the team through technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while applying strong engineering judgment to validate their output, improve development velocity, and identify opportunities where AI can create additional leverage.

 

How We Work

  • Autonomy & Ownership: Engineers have end-to-end responsibility for their services, from design and implementation to production and on-call.
  • Collaboration: Architecture and technical direction are shaped together. Senior engineers are expected to contribute actively to decisions and help others arrive at strong solutions.
  • Scalability & Simplicity: We value pragmatic solutions that solve today's problems while providing a sustainable foundation for tomorrow.
  • Impact: We work closely with Product, Data Science, and Operations, connecting technical decisions directly to real-world retail and operational outcomes.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our primary backend languages are Go and Kotlin.

We also use Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, GitHub Actions, and modern cloud infrastructure.

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We're more interested in strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals and your ability to learn and make sound technical decisions.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who:

  • Have strong experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems.
  • Have professional experience with Go, Kotlin, or another modern backend language.
  • Have experience owning services end-to-end, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, reliability, and production operations.
  • Have strong knowledge of backend and distributed systems fundamentals, including APIs, databases, asynchronous processing, failure handling, testing, and observability.
  • Are comfortable working with data-heavy systems and technologies such as Kafka, Snowflake, or similar streaming and data infrastructure.
  • Can navigate ambiguous problems, break them into actionable steps, make appropriate technical trade-offs, and deliver incrementally.
  • Can influence technical decisions beyond their immediate tasks and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners.
  • Communicate technical concepts and decisions clearly and concisely.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively in their everyday engineering workflow while critically evaluating generated solutions and taking full ownership of the resulting code and technical decisions.
  • Look for opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity and solve problems more effectively, while understanding where human engineering judgment remains essential.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following is a plus:

  • Forecasting, optimization, scheduling, recommendation, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, logistics, supply chain, or warehouse technology.
  • ERP, vendor management, procurement, or workforce management integrations.
  • Replacing third-party or legacy platforms with internally built systems.
  • High-throughput event-driven or streaming architectures.

 

Why Join Us?

You'll help build the technology that powers DoorDash's global grocery and retail business, solving complex operational challenges across inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, pricing, and supply chain.

You'll have significant ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence technical direction while working closely with experienced engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams across multiple markets.

📍 This role is based in our tech hub in Helsinki or Stockholm. We work in distributed teams, but may not be able to support fully remote work or relocation.

 

Next Steps

We're reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

You can read more about our recruitment process here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

opportunities.title: Principal Infrastructure Architect: Data Platform
opportunities.description: Headquarters: Remote ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast. As a Principal Infrastructure Architect on our Infrastructure Architecture team, you will be the architecture team's partner to ZoomInfo's data engineering organization. Data engineering owns the platforms and the products built on them. You bring the infrastructure patterns, evaluation rigor, and cross-team alignment that help them build and run those platforms well on GCP. This is a cloud architect seat with a data specialty. You bring the same cloud, Kubernetes, networking, and infrastructure-as-code foundation as the rest of the architecture team, plus enough hands-on depth in data systems to be credible with the engineers who run them. The work breaks down four ways: Patterns. You establish and maintain the paved-road patterns data teams build on: infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data jobs and pipelines, monitoring and alerting, performance, and cost. You keep them easy to consume and self-service. Enablement and alignment. You help data teams adopt those patterns, review their designs, and work through hard infrastructure trade-offs with them. Evaluation. You run POCs of new data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process, and you write recommendations engineering leaders can act on. Shared stewardship. You take a full share of the architecture team's general work: weekly architecture reviews across all domains, standards and ADRs, and infrastructure consulting for any team that needs it. The data estate is broad. We don't expect deep experience across all of it. We expect real depth in some areas and the ability to build depth in others as the work demands. Patterns get adopted here through leadership and communication rather than positional authority. You'll write reference implementations, open the first PRs, and stay hands-on through enablement when a critical initiative calls for it. What You'll Do Establish infrastructure patterns for data workloads. Design and maintain reference patterns for provisioning and operating the data platforms ZoomInfo runs: streaming and messaging (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub), operational databases (PostgreSQL/Cloud SQL, MongoDB), analytical stores (BigQuery, Snowflake), search (Elasticsearch/Solr), pipeline orchestration and processing (Apache Airflow/Cloud Composer, Dataflow/Apache Beam), and open table formats (Apache Iceberg). Ship them as Terraform modules, GitOps workflows, and documented standards that data teams can adopt without reinventing them. Build the data paved road. Today's delivery tooling is application-centric. Define CI/CD and GitOps patterns for data jobs and pipelines, and partner with platform engineering and data engineering to make data delivery as safe and automated as application delivery. Establish performance, cost, and observability patterns. Give data teams the patterns and guidance to run stores and pipelines efficiently (query and storage optimization, partitioning and clustering, tiering and retention, workload isolation, right-sizing) and the monitoring, alerting, and SLO practices that make performance and cost visible. Set the baseline patterns for backup, restore, and disaster recovery of data stores, including RTO/RPO targets. Partner with FinOps on data-layer spend. Review workloads with teams against these patterns and help them align. Evaluate new technologies. Run structured POCs of emerging data technologies and vendor offerings as part of the procurement and technology-lifecycle process. Recent examples include graph and distributed SQL databases, stream processing (Apache Flink, Confluent Flink), and schema management and cataloging. Weigh self-hosted against vendor-managed, map migration and exit paths, model cost, and write up a recommendation. Bring managed data services inside the perimeter. Define the patterns for connecting vendor-managed data planes (Confluent Cloud, Snowflake, MongoDB Atlas, and similar) to our GCP environment: private connectivity (Private Service Connect, PrivateLink, VPC peering), VPC Service Controls, identity and encryption across the boundary (workload identity, CMEK, in-transit), and the DNS and routing that go with them. Model egress and cross-region cost, and set the exfiltration controls that keep those services inside the compliance perimeter. Support data consolidation and governance efforts. Contribute infrastructure guidance to data engineering's work on consolidating where data lives and is accessed (BigQuery, Snowflake, object storage) and on data classification, residency, and access policy. Prototype and hand off. Build the reference implementation, write the ADR, and partner with the owning teams to roll the pattern out. Stay hands-on through POC and initial enablement. Participate in architecture review. Bring a consistent, documented rubric to weekly architecture reviews across all domains, including designs that have nothing to do with data. opportunities.title: Software Engineer (m/f/d) Industrial Robot Control
opportunities.description:
The Robotics & Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Software Engineer (m/f/d) Industrial Robot Control, who will develop C++ control software for the robot arm, from single-motor to multi-body control. 

Responsibilities

  • Control Software: Design and develop C++ software for the robot's control stack, covering kinematics, trajectory generation, and compliance control from single-motor to multi-body coordination.
  • Hardware Tuning: Support parameter identification and controller-gain tuning against physical hardware, working alongside more senior engineers to close the gap between simulation and real behavior.
  • Real-Time Performance: Profile control software and help keep it within the timing margins the arm's safety and stability depend on.
  • Hardware Validation: Write automated software tests, define hardware testing procedures, and work hands-on with the robot to confirm control software behaves correctly outside simulation.
  • Code Quality: Take part in code reviews with the wider team, both giving and receiving feedback that keeps the control codebase maintainable.
  • Technology Evaluation: Investigate and evaluate emerging robotic control methods and algorithms relevant to the team's work.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Degree in computer science, control engineering, mechatronics, or a related engineering field, with one to three years of professional experience in C++ development, or an equivalent record of relevant academic or project work.
  • Kinematics & Dynamics: Working understanding of robot kinematics and dynamics, sufficient to reason about forward and inverse mappings and trajectory generation for a multi-body arm.
  • Control Engineering: Background in control engineering, with some exposure to parameter identification and controller tuning.
  • Modern C++: Working proficiency in modern C++, including thread-safe and exception-safe code, and comfort working across the standard build, test, and debugging toolchain on Linux.
  • Hardware Troubleshooting: Basic ability and willingness to troubleshoot and debug directly on physical robotic hardware, not only software running in isolation.

Beneficial Skills

  • Python: Working programming skills in Python or a similar scripting language, used alongside C++ for tooling and analysis.
  • CI/CD Ownership: Experience maintaining or extending CI/CD pipelines for a C++ codebase.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zunächst Kund:innen in Berlin mit großartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.

Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.

Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.

Erfahre mehr über unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn und entdecke die neuesten Updates im Wolt Deutschland Newsroom.

Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt

  • Identifikation & Akquise: Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.
  • Pipeline-Management: Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.
  • Überzeugende Präsentation: Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.
  • Präsenz vor Ort: Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst: Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.
  • Performance-Drive: Du willst der Beste sein und die Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.
  • Selbstorganisation: Du planst deine Walk-in-Routen effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.
  • Positives Mindset: Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.
  • Qualifikation & Sprache: Studium oder Ausbildung, fließendes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir anbieten:

  • Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels: Wir verändern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit für Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.
  • Wachstum & Impact: Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unsere bereits etablierten Märkte in Berlin auf das nächste Level.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Arbeite selbständig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.
  • Mobilität & Equipment: Du erhältst Top-Hardware (iPhone & MacBook) und die Option auf einen Firmenwagen für deine Einsätze im Außendienst.
  • Wolt-Benefits: Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, ÖPNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten. 

Nächste Schritte

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:

  1. Recruiter Screening: Ein erstes Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation für Wolt kennenzulernen.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: Ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager, in dem wir mehr über deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Motivation für die Rolle erfahren möchten.
  3. Role Play: Eine praxisnahe Sales-Übung, bei der du uns deinen Ansatz bei der Kundenansprache, im Pitch und im Umgang mit Einwänden zeigen kannst.

Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?

Wir verändern nicht nur den Handel – wir geben den Menschen Zeit für das zurück, was sie wirklich lieben. Wenn du in einem High-Growth-Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen willst und ein Team suchst, das Ambition mit Spaß verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam den Markt revolutionieren!

Wichtiger Hinweis: Um deine Daten bestmöglich zu schützen (GDPR), akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze ausschließlich unsere Karriereseite für deine Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

opportunities.title: Mechanical Engineer in Production [Mid-Senior; F/M/D]
opportunities.description: Your mission If you're a mechanical engineer and want to apply your skills to food production technology, this is your chance to develop innovative mechanical systems for plant-based meat manufacturing, this is your chance to take the next step and take operational responsibility. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing, purpose-driven startup. Key responsibilities Machinery Installation & Commissioning: Support installation of new food processing equipment, perform commissioning and validation procedures, and conduct functional testing to ensure proper operation before production use. Continuous Modification & Improvement: Analyze existing processes and equipment performance, identify improvements, and design modifications to increase efficiency, reliability, and food safety compliance. Implement optimizations in the production environment. Equipment Repair & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, integrated and pneumatic equipment failures. Troubleshoot complex issues in mixers, conveyors, industrial machines, and automation equipment. Implement timely repairs to minimize production downtime. Mechanical Design & Process Optimization: Build and test mechanical prototypes and operational processes, validate design performance through testing and prototyping, iterate designs based on production feedback and food safety requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, R&D and quality teams to optimize equipment performance and resolve complex production challenges. Communicate equipment status and maintenance needs to production planning and leadership. Technical documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including S.O.P.s, schematics, mechanical drawings, process diagrams, and system specifications. Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors, contractors, and service providers. Coordinate procurement activities, oversee contractor performance, and ensure project deliverables meet specifications. Your profile In this role, you'll be responsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developing mechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, and supporting the mechanical engineering needs of our production operations. As a hands-on mechanical engineer, you'll work on everything from equipment design to production support. Requirements Professional Experience: 5-8 years of mechanical engineering experience in production or manufacturing environment, preferably with exposure to food processing, manufacturing equipment, or automated systems. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related technical field. Strong foundation in equipment maintenance, reliability engineering, and manufacturing processes. Knowledge of food industry applications preferred. Technical Skills: Knowledge of manufacturing processes and production optimization techniques, familiarity with lean manufacturing principles. Strong troubleshooting abilities with hands-on experience developing mechanical solutions and diagnosing and repairing mechanical equipment failures. Proficiency with CAD software, process modeling tools, and manufacturing software systems. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience in root cause analysis and process troubleshooting. Ability to interpret production data and develop longlasting cost effective engineering solutions. Operational Agility: A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional level in the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Why us? Why you should apply now Scaling Big: We’re at an exciting inflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scaling operations. Be part of something transformative and build it from the ground up. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and angels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time is Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away from animal-based meat, fast! A word on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion We embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared values and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, or marital status. Workspace and culture We’re building something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Our team thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power of face-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively. Currently, we spend most of our time together at our workplace in Berlin to nurture our team spirit and culture. As we grow over the next few years, we aim to evolve into a more distributed workplace, blending the flexibility of remote work with the strength of our shared values and connection.   • Utilize a consultative approach, discuss business issues with prospect and develop a formal quote, a written sales proposal or a formal sales presentation addressing their business needs.
  • Develop an account plan to sell to customers based on their business needs.

Requirements

  • Experience selling into highly complex organizations
  • Demonstrated consistent results and overachievement of quota
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to C-Level executives.

opportunities.title: Director of Sales, Europe
opportunities.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Director of Sales, Europe will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.
  • Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.
  • Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.
  • Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.
  • Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.
  • Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.
  • Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.
  • Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.
  • Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.
  • Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).
  • Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense procurement frameworks (e.g., NCI Agency, FMS/DCS, national MoD acquisition bodies) across Northern Europe and Allied Command structures, with a focus on key Nordic nations (Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark).
  • An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.
  • Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.
  • Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.
  • A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

Why we care so much about Belonging. 
We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.

opportunities.title: (Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d)
opportunities.description:
Willst Du mit Deiner Arbeit echten Impact leisten und aktiv an einer sicheren digitalen Zukunft mitbauen? Dann bist Du bei uns richtig. Denn Cyber Security ist mehr als nur ein Trend – sie ist eine der zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Du entwickelst Kunden strategisch weiter, erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und baust nachhaltige Beziehungen auf. Gleichzeitig bieten wir Dir ein Umfeld, in dem Du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst: kurze Entscheidungswege, echtes Vertrauen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Perspektive zählt – deshalb laden wir Dich aktiv ein, Deine Erfahrung einzubringen, ob regional, in bestimmten Branchen (Verticals) oder mit einem fachlichen Schwerpunkt. Wir glauben an Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge vorantreiben wollen.

Bei uns übernimmst Du Verantwortung, gestaltest aktiv mit und arbeitest in einem ambitionierten Team, das sich gegenseitig stärkt und gemeinsam wächst. Klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Cyber Security.

„Cyber Security lebt von Vertrauen, starken Beziehungen und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen. Genau deshalb suchen wir keinen klassischen Vertriebler, sondern jemanden, der Kunden strategisch entwickelt, Chancen erkennt und Themen nachhaltig vorantreibt. Bei uns bekommst du viel Eigenverantwortung, direkten Einfluss und ein Team, das ambitioniert arbeitet, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.“ Patrick Aigner, Head of Account Management

Du fühlst Dich angesprochen? Unser Team wächst stetig und wir suchen Dich als (Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d) an einem unserer Standorte oder Remote.

WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST

  • Betreuung und strategische Entwicklung von Bestandskunden (Mittelstand bis Großkunden) in einem definierten Gebiet
  • Ausbau und Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen sowie Erweiterung des Netzwerks auf Fach- und Managementebene
  • Planung und Koordination sämtlicher Vertriebsaktivitäten inklusive Präsentationen, Events und Messen
  • Gewinnung neuer Kunden auf Basis qualifizierter Leads sowie Aufbau eines eigenen Zielkundenportfolios
  • Erstellung von Angeboten und Verträgen sowie Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung des Leistungsportfolios

WIE DU UNS BEGEISTERST

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung/Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich
  • Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung sowie fundierte IT-Kenntnisse, idealerweise in der IT-Security
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie sicheres Auftreten im Kundenkontakt
  • Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste und belastbare Arbeitsweise mit hoher Flexibilität
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Reisebereitschaft sowie Führerschein der Klasse B

FEEL GOOD KULTUR @SITSGROUP

  • Wertschätzung: Eine offen-herzliche, respektvolle und wertschätzende Kommunikationskultur steht bei uns an erster Stelle.
  • Teamspirit: Es erwarten Dich spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben gepaart mit einem tollen und unterstützenden Team um Dich herum. Wir fördern nicht nur eine gesunde, sondern auch kollegiale Teamstruktur.
  • Onboarding & Einarbeitung: Wir legen großen Wert auf ein strukturiertes Onboarding und eine intensive Einarbeitung. Wir möchten, dass Du bei uns gut ankommst!
  • Work-Life-Blending: Wir bieten Dir die Option auf mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit Fokus auf eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance.
  • Perspektiven: Du erhältst vielfältige Freiräume für kreatives Arbeiten, persönliche Entwicklungsoptionen und interessante Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten – auch im Team.
  • Corporate Benefits: Auf Dich warten interessante und zahlreiche Mitarbeiterkonditionen.
  • Hire a Friend!: Empfehle Deinen Wunschkollegen! Unser lukratives Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm liegt uns besonders am Herzen und macht sich auch für Dich bezahlt!
  • Modern Workplace: Du erhältst von uns eine moderne IT-Ausstattung (bspw. Firmenlaptop, Headsets, Zweitbildschirm, Smartphone etc.).
  • Großartige Unternehmenskultur: Wir pflegen eine offene Du-Kultur und feiern legendäre größere und kleinere Teamevents!

ÜBERZEUGT? SO GEHT’S WEITER

Wir freuen uns über Deinen aussagekräftigen CV, den Du über das untenstehende Formular hochladen kannst. Ein Anschreiben darfst Du gerne weglassen.

Solltest Du uns noch weitere Dokumente zur Verfügung stellen wollen, kannst Du sie in diesem Feld einfügen.

Wir freuen uns sehr Dich kennenzulernen!

DU WILLST NOCH MEHR ÜBER UNS WISSEN?

SITS Group - Sicherheit braucht Partner: Als führende Unternehmensgruppe für IT Security stehen wir für eine ganzheitliche Sicherheit. Mit über 700 Mitarbeitenden vereint die SITS Group Erfahrung, Kompetenz, Ressourcen und Services hochkarätiger IT Security-Provider zu einem umfassenden Ganzen. Für unsere Kunden bieten wir mithilfe innovativer Lösungen und Technologien Gesamtkonzepte zur IT Security, die auf den Aspekten Schützen, Erkennen und Abwehren beruhen. Dazu zählen der Einsatz maßgeschneiderter Strategien, die Sensibilisierung der Mitarbeitenden sowie weitreichende Servicepakete. Sämtliche Prozesse in Unternehmen werden immer stärker digital vernetzt. Dank aufeinander abgestimmter Maßnahmen und einem mehrschichtigen Schutzsystem sind unsere Kunden für die Zukunft gewappnet.

Hilf uns die IT-Sicherheit unserer Kunden zu schützen und werde Teil unserer großartigen Vision mit einem einzigartigen Teamgeist.

KONTAKT

Bei Fragen kannst Du Dich gerne per Email an ▶ Mirthe Bakker (Talent Acquisition Partner) wenden.

opportunities.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung Vertrieb
opportunities.description: Mut ist unser Antrieb, Zusammenhalt ist unsere Stärke. Seit über 160 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen zuverlässig durchs Leben – mit einem innovativen Portfolio an Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeprodukten. Als Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit gestalten wir gemeinsam mit mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft der Versicherung neu und legen dabei besonderen Wert auf soziale und ökologische Verantwortung. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herzstück unseres Erfolgs. Wir leben eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur und heißen Menschen jeden Alters, jeder Herkunft und Lebensweise willkommen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten wollen. Kurz zusammengefasst – das erwartet dich Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Team bei der stetigen persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebspartnerinnen und Vertriebspartner innerhalb unserer Vertriebsorganisationen sowie bei der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Gemeinsam mit dem Team organisierst du Schulungen und unterstützt bei allen anfallenden Aufgaben rund um unsere Akademie, von der Planung bis zur Nachbereitung. Die Betreuung unserer Webinare liegt in deinen Händen: Du koordinierst Termine und Inhalte mit Referierenden, legst Veranstaltungen im Lernmanagementsystem an, bewirbst diese und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Für neue Mitarbeitende planst und koordinierst du gemeinsam mit den Trainerinnen die passenden Trainingsangebote, behältst Neueintritte im Blick und stimmst dich mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern ab. Im Rahmen der Akademie-Administration kümmerst du dich um Anmeldungen, Dokumentationen sowie die Pflege von Ein- und Austritten und sorgst für aktuelle und verlässliche Daten. In engem Austausch mit den Trainerinnen begleitest du die Entwicklung unserer Trainees, dokumentierst Fortschritte und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung von Lern- und Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du an der Optimierung digitaler Trainingsformate in Retorio mit, betreust Lernkohorten und unterstützt bei organisatorischen Themen wie Kick-off-Terminen, Projekten und der Rechnungsbearbeitung. Das bringst du mit Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, (Wirtschafts-)Pädagogik, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie, Personalmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und kannst uns für mindestens zwei Semester mit 18 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Personalentwicklung, Aus- und Weiterbildung, Organisationsentwicklung, Vertriebsmanagement oder Prozessoptimierung gesammelt. Der Umgang mit Microsoft Office und digitalen Anwendungen fällt dir leicht. In neue Tools und Systeme arbeitest du dich schnell und gerne ein. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig, behältst Termine im Blick und setzt auch bei mehreren Themen die richtigen Prioritäten. Kommunikation zählt zu deinen Stärken: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern zusammen, stimmst dich proaktiv ab und bist ein verlässlicher Teamplayer. Mit deiner positiven Art, deiner Eigeninitiative und deiner Begeisterung für die Weiterentwicklung von Trainings und Prozessen bringst du frische Ideen ins Team ein. Neugierig geworden? opportunities.description: Your mission The Bikeleasing Group continues to grow and is expanding its international tax function. As a Senior Tax Manager (gn), your initial focus will be on our tax matters in Germany. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to develop international topics and structures together with the relevant stakeholders. Close collaboration with external tax advisory firms, specialist departments, authorities and our parent company will be part of your daily work. The position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Germany and includes occasional business travel. Sounds good? Then we look forward to getting to know you. Your tasks You will manage the Bikeleasing Group’s tax matters independently, initially with a focus on Germany and increasingly on international topics in the future You will prepare tax returns, tax declarations, input tax refund claims and withholding tax applications carefully and on time You will be responsible for tax calculations in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) as well as the IFRS reporting package for our parent company You will continuously monitor, document and optimise intra-group transfer pricing You will actively contribute your expertise to VAT-related matters and tax audits As the central point of contact for specialist departments, external tax advisory firms and authorities, you will provide clarity on complex tax matters You will further develop international tax topics and tax processes together with the relevant stakeholders Your profile A completed degree in business administration, economics or law with a focus on taxation, or a comparable qualification At least five years of professional experience in the tax department of a company or at an auditing or tax advisory firm In-depth knowledge of German tax law and, ideally, international tax law Practical experience with accounting in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and, ideally, knowledge of IFRS Familiarity with group structures and the related accounting requirements A successfully completed German tax consultant examination is desirable A structured and precise approach to work, as well as confidence when dealing with authorities and external partners Why us? Around your working day Flexible working hours and flexitime help you balance work and private life. Workation: Once a year, you can work remotely from another EU country—or from a country where you hold a valid work permit—for up to three weeks. You’ll receive modern equipment for working both in the office and remotely. Clear vision at work matters to us. If you need prescription glasses for your workplace, we’ll contribute €100 towards the cost. You’ll benefit from a wide range of training opportunities and a transparent process to support your professional and personal development. A summer party and regular team events give you the chance to connect and share experiences. More for life Every month, you’ll receive a €50 non-cash benefit voucher—for example, to spend on corporate fitness, groceries, DIY stores, fuel or online shopping. For your birthday, you’ll receive a €60 voucher that can be redeemed with the same providers. You’ll receive a €40 contribution towards capital-forming benefits. You can take out an occupational pension plan with our partner, ERGO. After your probationary period, you can lease up to two bicycles, e-bikes or pedelecs through us. Parents receive up to five fully paid child-sick days per child each year, up to a maximum of 12 days per year. We grant up to two days of special leave for certain life events. With Bike2future, you get 10% off used bikes and leasing offers, plus two weeks to test the bikes you choose. With a subscription, the first four weeks are free and the €99 setup fee is waived. Through Corporate Benefits and exclusive employee discounts, you’ll enjoy attractive offers from a wide range of partners. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. Weitere Sprachen unserer Märkte (ES, FR, IT, PL, NL) sind von Vorteil. Vertragssicherheit bei Rahmenverträgen, Nutzungs- und Lizenzrechten sowie SLAs. Erfahrung mit P2P-Systemen wie Coupa, idealerweise inkl. Katalogaufbau und Punchout. Von Vorteil: Grundverständnis der Media-Welt (CPM, GRP, Kickbacks, Agentur-Vergütungsmodelle).
